global_rules.full_coverage_required: All 19 categories must be checked. Do not omit, merge, rename, skip, or reorder categories.
global_rules.evidence_required_for_hit: Every hit must have concrete evidence from allowed materials and must identify the source slice/material.
global_rules.no_extra_policy: Only the listed category definitions and thresholds may be used. Do not invent new policy categories.
global_rules.foreign_language_handling: Understand ASR/OCR in the original foreign language. Final evidence explanation must be Chinese; direct quotes may remain in original language.
global_rules.product_image_permission: Product images may only be used by categories listed in product_image_allowed_category_ids.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 若直播内容无明确、持续的商品推广、讲解、演示行为，核心内容与绑定商品无任何关联，一律优先判定为【商品无关低质问题】，不得判定为【商品描述不详细低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: If there is no clear sustained product promotion, explanation, or demonstration intent and the core live content is unrelated to bound products, classify as category 3 and do not classify as category 6.

exclusive_priority_rules.rule_zh: 色情暴露、性暗示类内容归为【色情低俗低质问题】，不得同时归为【隐私敏感商品低质问题】。
exclusive_priority_rules.rule_en: Sexual exposure or sexualized implication belongs to category 1, not category 19.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 of 5 slice images or 5 ASR snippets hits the listed visual or speech scenario.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面或语音中出现明确列出的性暗示、性挑逗、低俗暴露类内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only flag listed sexualized exposure or sexualized behavior. Do not flag ordinary cleavage unless deliberately sexualized by action such as bending over.
exemptions: Non-deliberate cleavage exposure is not enough.
Normal bikini in beach context is generally public-appropriate.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 image or ASR snippet hits. Visual hit requires disgusting/horror content covering over 50% of indoor scene and no active cleaning. ASR hit requires mentioning such scene and no cleaning.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面或语音中出现符合标准的令人不适、恐怖恶心内容，正在清洁相关场景一律豁免。
categories.judge_focus_en: Cleaning behavior or cleaning-product use exempts this category.
exemptions: Any active cleaning of the disgusting/horror environment is exempt.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit if at least 3 ASR snippets are fully unrelated to bound products, or at least 3 frame groups show no clear bound product and matching ASR is unrelated, or image+ASR unrelated counts total >= 6.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播核心内容与直播间绑定商品的电商推广无任何关联，无有效、持续的商品推广行为。
categories.judge_focus_en: Use bound product image category/function/use-case as reference. This category has priority over category 6 when there is no clear product promotion intent.

categories.trigger_threshold: At least 4 of 5 ASR snippets meet both: no product promotion and no host-audience interaction.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播内容既无商品推广行为，也无主播与观众的互动行为。
categories.judge_focus_en: A single snippet hit requires both no product promotion and no audience interaction.

categories.category_name: 无实物商品展示低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: At least 4 of 5 slice frame groups show no real physical display of bound product, only sticker/cutout/photo/screenshot/static image, no product, or only unrecognizable partial product.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面中未以真实视频画面形式展示直播间绑定的实物商品。
categories.judge_focus_en: ASR/OCR are supporting evidence only when relevant. Main judgment is visual physical product display compared with bound product images.

categories.category_name: 商品描述不详细低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 4 image/ASR evidence units, but only if clear product promotion intent and sustained product display/explanation/demonstration exist.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 主播有明确商品推广、讲解、演示意图和持续行为，但未提供有效商品信息或讲解内容跑题。
categories.judge_focus_en: Do not apply this category if there is no clear promotion intent; category 3 has priority in unrelated-content cases.
exemptions: Merely wearing or showing product with no promotion/explanation is exempt.
Unrelated live content with no promotion intent belongs to category 3, not category 6.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 of 5 slice image groups shows an occlusion/interruption layer covering at least 80% of the live screen and seriously blocking viewing.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播画面中出现覆盖大面积区域的遮挡层，严重影响观众观看。
categories.judge_focus_en: Both 80%+ coverage and serious viewing interference are required.

categories.trigger_threshold: Hit only when ASR/OCR contains Chinese/CJK used in product promotion, Chinglish, incomprehensible English, or severely broken English that prevents normal product understanding.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播语音或画面文本中出现不符合要求的中文、中式英语、无法理解的英文内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Normal English/local EU-language mixing is not a hit. German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, and other EU language words mixed with English are normal. German "Englisch" is a local-language word, not misspelled English. Isolated OCR noise, stylized labels, usernames, product names, or minor spelling mistakes are not enough unless overall promotion text becomes incomprehensible. Minor understandable accent is not a hit. Coworker casual Chinese unrelated to product promotion is exempt.
exemptions: Coworker daily Chinese conversation unrelated to product promotion.
Minor accent that is easy to understand.
Normal English/local EU-language mixing, including German, French, Spanish, Italian, Dutch, Polish, or other EU language words mixed with English.
German "Englisch" as a local-language word.
Isolated OCR noise, stylized labels, usernames, product names, or minor spelling mistakes unless overall promotion text becomes incomprehensible.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 image/ASR/OCR evidence shows AIGC-generated content used for product promotion that misleads authenticity or differs from bound physical product.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中使用 AIGC 生成内容进行商品推广，存在误导、虚假、与绑定实物商品不符的问题。
categories.judge_focus_en: Focus on misleading AI voice/interview, fake before/after effects, digital human without real bound product, or AI traces that mislead product authenticity.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 image/ASR/OCR evidence shows rendered/generated product or use scene with exaggerated size/style/effect compared with bound real product.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中通过 AIGC 生成商品或使用场景，存在渲染内容、与绑定真实商品夸张不符的问题。
categories.judge_focus_en: Distinguish from category 9: this focuses on generated product/use-scene display quality and mismatch.

categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 image/ASR evidence shows clear replay/loop/pre-recorded indicators such as replay/loop labels, playback controls, video timeline, repeated sequence, abnormal jump, black/green screen, nested screen with clear replay/loop/pre-recorded feature, or ASR directly mentioning replay/loop playback. Browser, desktop, card-list, or spin UI alone in card-opening or lottery-like live rooms is not enough.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播间存在预录内容循环播放的相关特征。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only clear replay indicators count. For card opening, TCG, trading-card, lottery/spin, or similar live rooms, browser/desktop/OBS-style interface, wheel/spin page, card-list page, or small host camera window is not replay by itself. Host face-cam used to prove real-time opening is exempt when host appears live or ASR aligns with mouth movement. A product-pointing cursor is exempt.
exemptions: Cursor used to point to or demonstrate product is exempt.
Browser, desktop, or OBS-style interface when consistent with real-time opening.
Wheel or spin page when consistent with real-time opening.
Card-list page when consistent with real-time opening.
Small host face-cam when consistent with real-time opening.

categories.category_name: 功能效果虚假宣传低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Any 1 image or ASR evidence shows exaggerated/unreliable product function or effect likely to mislead consumers.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中通过夸张拍摄手法、不真实或夸大的信息，使商品功能效果超出实际可靠范围并误导消费者。
categories.judge_focus_en: Use a skeptical reliability lens. Ordinary improvement, price, or discount claims without exaggerated effect are not hits.
exemptions: Ordinary product improvement, price, or discount information without exaggerated effect is exempt.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show life-threatening violent behavior or dangerous goods demonstration, including heavy-smoke products creating fire illusion.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现危及生命安全的暴力行为、危险物品展示。
categories.judge_focus_en: Normal product demonstration and safe behavior are exempt.
exemptions: Normal product demonstration, explanation, and safe behavior.

categories.category_name: 站外引流交易低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Any scene that simultaneously has payment/off-platform account/site info and explicit transaction guidance, with no exemption.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中引导用户通过平台外渠道完成交易。
categories.judge_focus_en: Both payment/off-platform info and transaction guidance must be present in the same scene. Vague link mention alone is not enough.
exemptions: Platform-internal order guidance.
Social account jump without purchase intent.
Bio link only with no live/comment transaction guidance.
Only one of the two core conditions present.

categories.category_name: 违法违规商品低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show legally prohibited goods, counterfeit, imitation, inferior product, or missing qualification claim tied to bound product.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中销售法律法规禁止的商品，或售卖假冒、仿冒、伪劣商品。
categories.judge_focus_en: Requires clear evidence tied to bound product. Normal legal products are exempt.
exemptions: Normal legal goods, regular brand goods, and ordinary product demonstrations.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show political controversy, sensitive political symbols/movements, political hate symbols, racial discrimination, or polarized political narratives.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现可能引发政治争议、涉及敏感政治符号、仇恨言论、种族歧视、极化政治叙事的内容。
exemptions: General non-political content unrelated to controversy or sensitive symbols.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show sensitive topics related to religion, racial discrimination, moral boundary, LGBT, or similarly high-conflict socio-cultural themes.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现与宗教信仰、种族歧视、道德边界、LGBT 相关的高度敏感争议内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Only the specified sensitive topic scope counts. Do not extend to unrelated controversy.
exemptions: General non-sensitive content outside the specified topic scope.

categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show persistent negative emotional guidance, wealth flaunting, hostile comparison, jealousy, resentment, irritability, dissatisfaction triggers, anxiety induction, or purchase-pressure emotion.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中出现抱怨吐槽、炫富攀比、易引发观众负面情绪的内容。
categories.judge_focus_en: Neutral or positive content unrelated to negative emotion triggering is exempt. In card opening, TCG, trading-card, lottery/spin, or similar live rooms, casual slang, short emotional reactions, disappointment about pull results, comments on card art/design, or hype words such as disgusting/crazy/insane used as slang are not a hit by themselves.
exemptions: General neutral or positive content.
Ordinary product comparison without negative emotion triggering.
Ordinary card-pull disappointment.
Casual streamer banter.
Slang or hype language without sustained negative guidance.
Comments on card art/design or pull luck that do not induce anxiety, resentment, jealousy, or purchase pressure.

categories.category_name: 隐私敏感商品低质问题
categories.trigger_threshold: Cumulative at least 2 image/ASR evidence units show intimate, gender-specific, or private-use non-pornographic product tied to bound product.
categories.hit_definition_zh: 直播中展示贴身、具有性别专属属性、隐私相关的非色情类商品。
categories.judge_focus_en: If sexual exposure or sexual implication exists, use category 1 instead. Normal shaver display is exempt unless used/displayed for private body parts.
exemptions: Normal shaver display in non-private context.
Sexual exposure/implication belongs to category 1, not category 19.
